reserveReview.rationale: Owner ruling 7 splits the original 34% unattributed non-FiRM issuance without asserting the entire tail is measured unsafe. Official repayments-v2 API fetched October 2 reports Frontier-specific bad debt 2,762,518.5942272837 DOLA at block 26104682 (timestamp 1790944612564), distinct from the Fed overview's Frontier circulating borrow counter 2,761,767.883082971. Dividing verified Frontier bad debt by the retained $108,602,244.08936833 September 29 supply denominator gives 2.543703%; the remaining 31.456297% is unclassified unknown. The retained FiRM slices come from the saved September 29 issuer payload; the freshly fetched fixed-markets API also reports current FiRM debt but does not identify this non-FiRM tail. This temporally mixed illustrative catalog split is not a synchronized current reserve valuation or a supply override. The October 2 review date records the bad-debt read, not a refresh of September 29 composition. LP debt remains undecomposed and no external stablecoin constituents are inferred. Only the verified Frontier slice supports measured unsafe attribution; the unidentified remainder must be bounded-unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Retained September 29 FiRM debt and $108,602,244.08936833 supply denominator; original 34% non-FiRM tail split using October 2 official Frontier bad debt, with explicit temporal mismatch
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: 64.3% remains undecomposed LP-secured debt; 31.456297% is unclassified non-FiRM issuance after separating 2.543703% verified Frontier bad debt. No favourable backing or measured danger is inferred for the unknown residual.
